main_text.p: Deniq; ignorantiam cum petulantia coniunctam non excusare quenquam. Dominus Iesus det nobis omnibus castam, puram & sanctam mentem, ut olim videre possimus Deum Opt.Max.& pulcherrimum, atque eundem & amare & laudare in secula seculorum, Amen.
main_text.head: CONCIO VI.
Genef. 16.

p.i: TAQ̄VE Sarai vxor Abrami non genuit illi: habuit autem ancillam Aegyptiam, nomine Hagar. Dixitque Sarai ad Abram: En prohibuit me dominus ne parerem, ingredere quaeso ad ancillam meam, si forte aedificer ex ea: & obediebat Abram voci Sarai. Tulitque Sarai uxor Abram, Hagar Aegyptiam ancillam suam, a fine decem annorum, quo habitauit Abram in terra Chanaan, et dedit eam Abra marito suo in uxorem. Qui cum ingressus esset ad Hagar, concepit illa: vidensque se gravidam, vilipensa est domina eius in oculis suis. Et dixit Sarai ad Abram: Iniuria mea super te est: ego dedi ancillam meam in sinum tuum,

page.notes: The initial "T" is a woodcut ornamental letter, read as T. The mark over "Abram" in "Abram" lines (printed as a small curved sign before the name) is an unidentified printed sign; it has been read as the name "Abram" without it, and the sign is not transcribed. "TAQ̄VE": the Q carries a stroke marking an omitted m, read as a macron over Q. The paragraph of the body text continues past the bottom of the page. The running head is read as NUPTIALES with the printed capitals spaced out.
